trending.title: Understanding Amazon Web Services (AWS)
trending.description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a cloud computing platform developed by Amazon that provides a wide range of on-demand services, including computing power, storage, databases, networking, and security. It enables individuals and organisations to build, manage, and scale applications without investing in expensive physical infrastructure. AWS is widely used because it is reliable, secure, flexible, and cost-effective, making it one of the most popular cloud platforms in the world.

trending.title: A Cost-Optimized Strategy for Archiving Small Files in Amazon S3
trending.description: Archiving millions of small files directly to Amazon S3 Glacier using Lifecycle rules can result in surprisingly high storage costs due to minimum billable object sizes, Lifecycle transition requests and Glacier metadata overhead. This article explains why bundling small files with s3tar before archiving can significantly reduce both storage and retrieval costs, making it a more cost-effective strategy for long-term data retention.
